High-level asks from our side:
- Can procurement confirm standard PO lead time and who will own the PO issuance?
- Can legal (Paul or GC) confirm preferred process for MSA/DPA redlines (single consolidated .pdf or inline Google Doc)?
- Target: align on a signature target week (we suggested week of 2026-03-08 during the call).

I’ve copied Marissa to help with sequencing on the MSA/DPA/order form and to propose realistic legal review SLAs. If that target is tight for you, say so and we’ll adjust.

Jordan —

Thanks for the note and the one-pager. A few quick points from procurement/legal side:

- Procurement: typical PO lead time is 7–10 business days once approvals are in place. We will need an internal cost center and SOW-level detail to route the PO.
- Legal: Paul (copied) will review, but our preference is a redline PDF. We have a standardized DPA appendix template for data residency and audit clauses that must be included.
- Compliance: we require evidence of SOC 2 Type II in the last 12 months and a description of data retention controls before we sign.

I’m attaching our ProcurementChecklist.xlsx to show the fields procurement needs. Paul — can you confirm whether your team will do a single consolidated redline or expect multiple rounds?

Thanks —
Emma Lowe
VP, IT & Procurement | HealthSprint
emma@healthsprint.com

Subject: Re: Legal railmap: evaluation -> signature timeline

Jordan / team / Emma —

Quick sequencing proposal from legal ops perspective (keeps the week-of-2026-03-08 signature target if we stick to the dates below):

1) Evaluation sign-off (customer product/POC) — owner: Emma — target 2026-02-19
2) Customer legal redline window — owner: Paul (HS) — 10 business days (2026-02-20 to 2026-03-05)
3) Redwood commercial responses & internal legal review — owner: Marissa/Karthik — 3 business days after redline receipt
4) Final commercial alignment & PO prep — owner: HealthSprint procurement — 5 business days
5) DocuSign routing and signature — owner: both — target week 2026-03-08

Notes / gating items:
- We’ll prepare an MSA + standard DPA appendix + order form bundle. To reduce round trips we recommend HealthSprint provide a single consolidated redline PDF (as Emma suggested).
- If SOC 2 evidence or additional security questionnaires are requested, that typically adds 3–5 business days; please flag urgently so we can provide.
- Laura: can you prepare the order form template we usually use for enterprise trials and include a short SOW placeholder (1–2 bullets) so procurement has the cost center / line items?

I’m attaching an internal guidance doc (MSA-redline-guidance.docx) with cadence language and suggested default positions to accelerate acceptance.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Counsel, Commercial | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

From: Paul Ortega <paul.ortega@healthsprint.com>

Cc: HealthSprint Procurement <procurements@healthsprint.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Legal railmap: evaluation -> signature timeline

Marissa / Jordan / Emma —

Attached are HealthSprint’s high-level redlines to the MSA (HealthSprint-redlines-msa.pdf). Key asks from our counsel:

- Explicit data retention and deletion window tied to the order form (we prefer 90 days after termination unless contractually extended).
- Audit window: annual SOC/controls audit notification and a 30-day cure period for any compliance findings.
- Indemnity: we will propose a capped indemnity tied to fees for third-party claims related to data misuse.

We can provide a consolidated PDF with comments; we prefer Redwood to propose text for the data retention clause and the DPA appendix.

If the parties can work off a single PDF and Redwood returns a clean counterproposal within 3 business days, we remain comfortable with a signature in the first half of March.

Paul Ortega
General Counsel | HealthSprint
paul.ortega@healthsprint.com

Attachments: HealthSprint-redlines-msa.pdf (stub)

Team —

Thanks for the redlines and the checklist. I’m attaching an updated MAP (MAP-final-v2.pdf) that folds Paul’s asks into milestone-level owners and hard dates. Summary of the consolidated plan:

- Evaluation sign-off: target 2026-02-19 (completed)
- HS provides consolidated redline PDF: target 2026-02-20 (received 2026-02-18)
- Redwood returns counterproposal (MSA + DPA appendix edits) including explicit data retention language: target 3 business days (2026-02-23) — COMPLETED
- HealthSprint legal final review & sign-off: target 2026-03-05
- Procurement issues PO: target 2026-03-09
- DocuSign signature routing: target 2026-03-09 to 2026-03-12
- Onboarding kickoff (technical) — tentative 2026-03-16

Action items for HealthSprint: confirm PO lead time and the internal approver name for the PO routing; confirm the 90-day retention preference (Paul suggested that, we proposed 90 days as a default but will accept an alternate if you specify).

Action items for Redwood: Marissa / Karthik / Laura will finalize the MSA+DPA bundle and upload to DocuSign by 2026-02-23 (link below).

Please confirm by EOD Friday 2026-02-28 if these milestones look OK, or call out any blockers.
